interaction_defect.best_approximation: For every real degree-N trigonometric polynomial f_N with sign s_M=sgn(sin(Mx_1)), int(f_N^2-1)^2>=||f_N-s_M||_2^2>=||s_M-P_<=N s_M||_2^2 by sign matching and Fourier best approximation
interaction_defect.defect_comparison: For the saturating partial sum, sgn(p_R)=s and T_R<=delta_R=int(p_R^2-1)^2<=(C_0+1)^2 T_R, so the lower bound is sharp up to a universal constant
interaction_defect.family_scale: The omitted square-wave tail is Theta(M/N) for 1<=M<=N; with C_N=Theta(N^2), the optimal exact-lamellar-sign Wick scale is Theta(N^3 M)
interaction_defect.cubic_floor: Since M>=1, every degree-N configuration with exact lamellar square-wave sign has W_N=Omega(N^3) and therefore misses an order-N^2 interaction budget before Fisher cost is counted
interaction_defect.scope_guard: The multiplication bound applies to the exact one-coordinate lamellar sign class; it does not lower-bound likelihoods supported on non-lamellar or genuinely three-dimensional textures
